charts.title: K2-315 b: orbits around K2-315
charts.description: The orbits of K2-315's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-315 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Niraula et al. 2020 (2020AJ....160..172N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NIRAULA_ET_AL__2020): P 3.1443189 d
